engines.label: Google Translate
engines.notes: Unofficial GTX (translate_a/single?client=gtx). No SLA; may stop working without notice.

engines.label: DeepL
engines.notes: Free keys end with :fx and use api-free.deepl.com; Pro keys use api.deepl.com. Authorization: DeepL-Auth-Key.

engines.label: Microsoft Translator
engines.notes: Azure Translator v3. Key is the subscription key. Optional region as key|region (Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Region).

engines.label: 百度翻译
engines.notes: 通用翻译 API. Store the key as appid:secret. sign = md5(appid+q+salt+secret).

engines.label: 有道
engines.notes: 有道智云文本翻译. Store the key as appKey:appSecret. signType=v3.

engines.label: 腾讯
engines.notes: 腾讯云 TMT TextTranslate 2018-03-21. Store the key as secretId:secretKey. TC3-HMAC-SHA256.
